MPPSC-2021-037.reason: The Objectives Resolution was moved on 13 December 1946. Whether that date is the second, third, fourth or fifth sitting of the Constituent Assembly depends on how sittings are counted: the Assembly sat on 9, 10, 11 and 13 December 1946, so 13 December is the fourth sitting by date, while accounts that count the Assembly's separate meetings, or begin with the 9 December formal sitting plus the 11 December business meeting, give the third or the fifth. The official key (D, Fifth) is retained and the counting ambiguity is stated.

MPPSC-2022-045.reason: The question asks where Buddhist CAVES are not situated. Bulsar (Valsad) has no Buddhist cave complex either. Both C and D are therefore defensible, so the original two-answer key is restored. An earlier internal pass cut this to D only by reasoning that any Buddhist site must have Buddhist caves, which does not follow. The item is defective: it should have had one clearly wrong option.
